look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Meet XORA
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 6 XORA Intelligence, lesson T24, Meet XORA; the tutor walks in beside a phone mock.

scenes.name: One engine, three modes
scenes.desc: What XORA is: one engine that runs in Demo (default, simulated fills), Live (real Binance futures orders, opt-in) or Live Support (alerts only).

scenes.name: Five tabs
scenes.desc: The five tabs light up in turn: Home, Signals, XORA (centre), Trades, Settings, each with what it shows.

scenes.name: The Home tab
scenes.desc: Home mock: next engine check countdown, setups waiting, DEMO pill, BTC card with sparkline, account row and your coins with statuses.

scenes.name: The Signals tab
scenes.desc: Signals mock: coin picker or Xora AI coin selection, price chart forming, trade opportunity card, entry checklist ticks, BUY / LONG and SHORT / SELL buttons.

scenes.name: The XORA tab
scenes.desc: XORA tab mock: entry, leverage, margin, risk zone; unrealised P&L counting with price; trailing stop moving up; close position.

scenes.name: Trades and Settings
scenes.desc: Trades mock (My Trades: Overview, Trades, Insights, wins and losses listed) then the Settings list.

scenes.name: The workflow
scenes.desc: Six-step workflow: pick coins, read a coin on Signals, a setup triggers, approve or place your own (or skip), manage on XORA, review in Trades.

scenes.name: You approve
scenes.desc: Auto trade approval off: a setup waits for Approve and expires with no trade; the manual order sheet says if the engine agrees or it is your call.

scenes.name: Trade Settings
scenes.desc: Trade Settings mock and a worked example: 3 USDT margin at 10x is a 30 USDT position; 2 concurrent trades is up to 60 USDT; a 1% move is 0.30 USDT.

scenes.name: Safety settings
scenes.desc: Four safety pieces animate: a stop on every trade (safety close), daily stop loss pausing entries until 00:00 IST, concurrent trades and one per coin, API key with withdrawals disabled.

scenes.name: A common mistake
scenes.desc: Mistake: Live on day one with high leverage; correction: Demo first, low leverage, every setup is a maybe.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and answer: auto approval is off and a setup triggers; the answer: it waits for your Approve or expires with no trade.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Risk cards: a tool not a guarantee, real losses in Live, leverage and fees, account security.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three points: one engine and three modes, five tabs and one workflow, safety settings.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T25, how XORA analyses a coin; risk line.
